Name: Max Forge Upgrades
Author: Xeru1998
Description:
[size=6]Max Forge Upgrades[/size]
[size=4]Version 1.1.0[/size]

This is a very lightweight mod that allows you to customize some behavior with weapons and the forge.
It is intentionally very feature sparse.

[size=5]Configuration Options[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Max Forge Upgrades[/b]: Sets the maximum number of times a weapon can be upgraded at the forge. [i](Vanilla 3)[/i][/*]
[*][b]Max Forge Level Per Gem Type[/b]: Sets the maximum number of times a weapon can be upgraded at the forge with a game of the same type. [i](Vanilla 3)[/i][/*]
[*][b]Base Upgrade Cost[/b]: Sets the base number of cinder shards to upgrade a weapon.[i] (Vanilla 10)[/i][/*]
[*][b]Upgrade Scaling Amount[/b]: Sets the number of additional cinder shards required per level to upgrade. [i](Vanilla 5)[/i][/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Translations[/size]
[list]
[*][b]English[/b]: Xeru98[/*]
[*]Please reach out if you would like to translate it (it's like 8 entries)[/*]
[/list]
